# 1 Enoch Chapter 50 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**50:1** And in those days a change shall come upon the holy and elect, and the light of days shall rest upon them, and glory and honor shall be given to the holy.

**50:2** On the day of affliction, evil will have been stored up against the sinners. And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of the Lord of Spirits; and he will cause the others to witness this, that they may repent and abandon the works of their hands.

**50:3** They shall have no honor through the name of the Lord of Spirits; yet through his name shall they be saved, and the Lord of Spirits will have compassion on them, for his compassion is great.

**50:4** And he is righteous also in his judgment, and in the presence of his glory unrighteousness shall not sustain itself; at his judgment the unrepentant shall perish before him.

**50:5** "And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them," says the Lord of Spirits.

---

*LOGOS notes: The brief window for repentance (vv. 2–3) is an important theological moment in the Parables. Even those who have no prior claim to God's name may be saved through it — a universalist possibility within an otherwise strict dualism. V. 5 is a divine oracle closing the offer.*
